title: 第25章 发放丹药第26章 纪妳镁
content_zh:
三天的时间，林炎一直在闭关之中度过。
而在这三天里，他从王长东那缴获的灵石也以肉眼可见的速度消耗一空，短短三天的时间，就花费五万灵石，这在林炎以前的认知中是想都不敢想的事。
不过这五万灵石并没有白费，他的修为接连突破，达到了气海二重之境！
“我从刚接触修炼到现在，也才几个月的时间而已，就已经从养气五重达到气海二重。”
“不过，九龙吞天诀虽然让我进步速度很快，可换来的代价却是消耗资源的速度是别人的好几倍，换做普通人从气海一重提升到二重，最多只需要一万灵石就够了，我却足足花费了五万。”
林炎暗叹。
境界越高，消耗的资源就越多。
气海二重就这样了，等气海四重，又会是何等烧钱？
更别说气海七重以后了，估计提升一个境界十万灵石都打不住！
这一刻，他深深地感觉到了资源贫乏！
没有资源，他以后修炼速度将会一落千丈。
“铛！”
这时宗门之中传来了一阵浩荡的钟声。
“居然到了宗门发放丹药的日子了吗？我优秀弟子的身份，再加上中三层榜首的位置应该可以领取不少资源。”
宗门每个月发放一次丹药，而发放丹药和灵石的数量，则跟身份有关，身份越高，奖励就越高。
优秀弟子每个月是一颗二品中级丹药。
林炎来到天才殿广场外，在天才殿外，他看到了和他有过不浅恩怨的尹海。
在尹海的身边，还有着一个青衣男子，他面冠如玉，长得很俊朗，瞥了一眼林炎，道：“尹海师弟，此人就是你说的林炎？”
“是的，青山师兄！”
尹海拱手道。

李青山微微点头，而后对林炎吩咐道：“既然你得罪了我师弟，那你就跪下来认个错吧！”
然而，林炎却连看都不看李青山，直接与李青山擦身而过，将其无视。
这让李青山愣了一下，而后脸上涌出暴怒的神情：
“很好，居然有人敢不把我李青山放在眼中！看来是我在外历练的这段时间，已经让宗门的人忘记了被李青山三个字支配的恐惧啊！”
“青山师兄，等会爷爷发放丹药，先饶过他。”
尹海道。
“行，等发放丹药完毕之后，再去新账旧账一起算。”
李青山微微点头。
……
“林炎师弟，你怎么来了？”
执事王林也来领取丹药，看到林炎出现，顿时脸色一变。
“我也是外山弟子，今天来此地当然是要领取丹药啊。”
林炎笑了笑。
“我不是说的这个……你难道不知道吗？今天发放丹药的，是尹龙长老！”
王林面色焦急。
林炎眉头一锁，当初加入宗门的时候，他就从马保国长老那得知尹海的爷爷尹龙，乃是外山长老，灵海境大能。
不过他并不着急：“就算尹海与我有恩怨，他身为长老级人物，也不能对我动手吧。”
content_en:
Lin Yan spent three days in seclusion.
In these three days, the spiritual stones he seized from Wang Changdong were consumed at a speed visible to the naked eye. In just three days, he spent 50,000 spiritual stones, which was something Lin Yan could not even imagine in his previous knowledge.
However, these 50,000 spirit stones were not in vain. His cultivation level broke through one after another and he reached the second level of Qi Sea!
"It has only been a few months since I first started practicing cultivation, and I have already reached the second level of Qi Sea from the fifth level of nourishing Qi."
"However, although the Nine Dragons Swallowing Heaven Technique allowed me to progress very quickly, the price in return was that I consumed resources several times faster than others. For an ordinary person to upgrade from the first level of Qi Sea to the second level, it would only require at most 10,000 spirit stones, but I spent a full 50,000."
Lin Yan sighed secretly.
The higher the realm, the more resources are consumed.
This is the second level of Qi Sea. How much money will it cost to wait for the fourth level of Qi Sea?
Not to mention after the seventh level of Qi Sea, even a hundred thousand spirit stones may not be able to reach a higher level!
At this moment, he deeply felt the lack of resources!
Without resources, his cultivation speed will plummet in the future.
"Cang!"
At this time, a loud sound of bells came from the sect.
"Has the day actually come for the sect to distribute elixirs? My status as an outstanding disciple, coupled with my position at the top of the middle and third levels, I should be able to receive a lot of resources."
The sect distributes elixirs once a month, and the number of elixirs and spiritual stones distributed is related to status. The higher the status, the higher the reward.
Outstanding disciples receive one second-grade intermediate elixir every month.
Lin Yan came to the outside of the Genius Hall Square. Outside the Genius Hall, he saw Yin Hai, who had a lot of grievances with him.
Next to Yin Hai, there was a man in green clothes. He had a jade-like face and was very handsome. He glanced at Lin Yan and said, "Junior brother Yin Hai, is this the Lin Yan you mentioned?"
"Yes, Senior Brother Qingshan!"
Yin Hai cupped his hands and said.
Li Qingshan nodded slightly, and then told Lin Yan: "Since you have offended my junior brother, then kneel down and admit your mistake!"
However, Lin Yan didn't even look at Li Qingshan, he just passed by Li Qingshan and ignored him.
This made Li Qingshan stunned for a moment, and then a furious look emerged on his face:
"Very good, someone actually dares not to take me, Li Qingshan, seriously! It seems that the time I have been training outside has made the people in the sect forget the fear of being dominated by the words Li Qingshan!"
"Senior Brother Qingshan, let me spare him for now when grandpa distributes the elixirs."
Yin Haidao.
"Okay, after the elixirs are distributed, we can settle the old and new accounts together."
Li Qingshan nodded slightly.
…
"Junior Brother Lin Yan, why are you here?"
Deacon Wang Lin also came to collect the elixir. When he saw Lin Yan appearing, his expression suddenly changed.
"I am also a disciple from outside the mountain. Of course I am here today to receive the elixir."
Lin Yan smiled.
"That's not what I'm talking about...don't you know? The person distributing the pills today is Elder Yin Long!"
Wang Lin looked anxious.
Lin Yan frowned. When he first joined the sect, he learned from Elder Ma Baoguo that Yin Hai's grandfather Yin Long was an elder from Waishan and a powerful person in the Linghai realm.
But he was not in a hurry: "Even if Yin Hai has a grudge against me, as an elder, he can't do anything to me."
